title: Reserve Base Sales for the Account-Level Reserve on Northloop Payments On-Demand Payouts
content:
**Definition.** The reserve base sales, on which the account-level reserve of a Northloop Payments on-demand payout is worked out, are the sale credits of the last month when the payments account was opened fewer than 730 calendar days before the request date, since such an account has no settled monthly average; when it was opened at least 730 but fewer than 1095 (1,095) days before, two candidate monthly measures are compared — one third of the sale credits of the last three months and one twelfth of the sale credits of the last twelve months, each rounded to the cent — and the larger of the two is the reserve base sales; otherwise the reserve base sales are one twelfth of the sale credits of the last twelve months, rounded to the cent.

A window of the last month, three or twelve months takes in the ledger entries dated after the same calendar day one, three or twelve months before the request date, up to and including the request date.

## Measure by account age

| Calendar days from the opening of the payments account to the request date | Reserve base sales |
|---|---|
| fewer than 730 | the sale credits of the last month |
| at least 730 and fewer than 1095 | the larger of one third of the three-month sale credits and one twelfth of the twelve-month sale credits, each rounded to the cent |
| 1095 or more | one twelfth of the twelve-month sale credits, rounded to the cent |

## Hypothetical worked examples

- *Opened 400 days before the request; sale credits of the last month 18000.00 USD.* Reserve base sales 18000.00 USD.
- *Opened 900 days before; three-month sale credits 45000.00 USD, twelve-month sale credits 120000.00 USD.* One third of 45000.00 is 15000.00; one twelfth of 120000.00 is 10000.00; the larger, 15000.00 USD, is the reserve base sales.
- *Opened 1500 days before; twelve-month sale credits 100000.00 USD.* One twelfth is 8333.333, rounded to 8333.33 USD.
- *Boundaries.* 729 days falls in the first row, 730 and 1094 in the second, 1095 in the third.
